data.summary: The dbt_semantic directory contains the core dbt configuration and connection profile files required to initialize and manage the semantic layer project on Trino.

file_insights.name: dbt_project.yml
file_insights.summary: Defines the core configuration and project settings for the dbt semantic project.
file_insights.source_summary: Defines the dbt project metadata, version, profile connection, and model paths, setting views as the default materialization.
file_insights.detailed_description: Configures the dbt project properties, profile bindings, model paths, and materialization defaults for the semantic layer.
responsibilities: Specify model paths for dbt models
Configure default materialization strategies for models

file_insights.name: profiles.yml
file_insights.summary: Configures database connection profiles and targets for running the dbt semantic layer on Trino.
file_insights.source_summary: Contains database configuration profiles specifying connection properties to Trino for analyst read queries and engineer build operations.
file_insights.detailed_description: Defines profiles, target environments, and connection properties (such as Trino connection details for query and build targets) for dbt and MetricFlow.
responsibilities: Configure database connection profiles for Trino
Define query and build execution targets
Specify authentication users and database connection parameters
